rationale: A commits to a ledger-paper art direction made for this brief: condensed display type sitting on ruled lines, folio-numbered sections, a live journal table, a control register and pricing set as a ledger, with one orange-red accent and a full-bleed orange sign-up close. Its headline lines mask-reveal in a staggered sequence that is complete by about 1.3 s, and the scroll adds a pinned request/entries/settled stepper, a word-by-word security statement and horizontally travelling customer slips. B is polished and has the richer single scene (the pinned payment-flow diagram with event stream, plus the region quorum graphic), but its dark background, lime accent, serif-italic emphasis word, bento cards and three-card pricing read as a familiar premium SaaS template. B's first viewport is also essentially blank for the first ~850 ms and shows headline and paragraph overlapping at 1.3 s, and its code panel leaves a large empty response area.
